failure_modes.name: First-Stage Candidate Miss (Vanishing Point Truncation)
failure_modes.observed_behavior: Ultra-distant sub-16px vehicles along vanishing line produce zero activations at 640px; candidate generator proposes no crop.
failure_modes.mitigation: Fixed-grid horizon strip or hybrid road band prior.
failure_modes.impact: Caps candidate-driven ROI small-object recall at 28.5%.

failure_modes.name: Crop Boundary Truncation Artifacts
failure_modes.observed_behavior: Vehicles severed in half by crop boundary trigger partial-car false detections.

failure_modes.name: Specular Water Reflection Hallucination
failure_modes.observed_behavior: High-magnification crops on wet asphalt magnify puddle reflections into car-like bounding boxes.
failure_modes.impact: Suppressed 74 false alarms on wet pavement.

failure_modes.name: Thermal Contrast Inversion & Hot Exhaust Blooming
failure_modes.observed_behavior: Hot car exhausts and warm engine hoods bloom into saturated thermal blobs, washing out wheel and windshield contours.
failure_modes.mitigation: Multi-scale feature normalization; thermal class prior.
